scope: Read the complete revised roadmap; independently rechecked the six requested corrections, O/D identification controls, comparison-arm completeness, estimands, and explicit execution-count boundaries. No model run or remote mutation was performed by this reviewer.

findings.prior_issue: L0 depended on the unarchived stable mathematical D while promising no refit.
findings.evidence: Section 4.1 now uses actually tested BF16 matrices and their matched pre-gate prediction difference; it explicitly identifies the F64 output-interpolation estimand and requires a separate actual BF16 writeback check for deployable shrink.
findings.assessment: The a/b overshoot versus direction diagnostic is mathematically valid for the declared interpolation and no longer assumes a missing artifact.

findings.prior_issue: Oddifying unspecified h could reduce GELU to a linear delta-only control.
findings.evidence: Section 5 fixes tanh, gives the delta-only arm both linear and nonlinear features/readouts, shares train-fold projections and scale, and explicitly notes the GELU odd-part degeneracy.
findings.assessment: The declared comparison now distinguishes endpoint and displacement-only feature families without claiming identical functional capacity.

findings.prior_issue: The 2% screening point threshold and CI rule were inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Section 5 requires the source-bootstrap 95% upper bound below -2%; crossing -2% is INCONCLUSIVE. The strongest linear baseline is selected in CAL CV and the development interval is not promoted to post-selection confirmation coverage.
findings.assessment: The resource-screening rule is unambiguous and tied to the explicit source/expert aggregation in Section 3.

findings.prior_issue: ICC stage-2 error share alone did not identify the effect of repairing or enlarging W2.
findings.evidence: Section 6.1 adds native/surrogate first-by-second four-cell counterfactuals, including approximate-hidden/native-W2; retains signed cross terms and BF16 boundaries; and conditions readout-specific CD-SVD attribution on a mixed-factor configuration.
findings.assessment: The design now separates descriptive error shares, actual fixed-input repairs, and equal-total-rank deployment candidates. The native-h result is not claimed as a universal lower bound for all stage-1 changes.

findings.prior_issue: Q1 student states could substitute incorrectly for the failing new candidate's states.
findings.evidence: Section 7 gives the failing candidate N its own same-CAL24 student collection with paid native targets, paired with Dense calibration, and bounds the process to one recalibration cycle.
findings.assessment: The relevant student-distribution hypothesis is tested without fitting on DEV or silently introducing an unbounded iterative loop.

findings.prior_issue: A lower motion-amplitude bound could pass excess or wrong-direction motion.
findings.evidence: Section 9.2 adds two-sided amplitude protection, RAFT direction, CoTracker normalized trajectory error and valid coverage, frozen visibility/denominator rules, and independent action completion.
findings.assessment: Motion preservation is no longer decided by amplitude alone; missing critical measurements make protection INCONCLUSIVE.

additional_rechecks.evidence: CAL24/DEV24 same-source subset, reused D4 trajectories, at most 48 new O40 trajectories in two scopes, fixed mixed-CAL operator-transfer table separate from equal-budget per-state adaptation, fixed G_ref, correct conditional-branch/CFG caveat, native pre-W1 interface, rebuilt per-weight anchors/caches, O-short/half/long, time/expert support-gap status, and source-paired method-difference interaction contrasts are all stated.

Seven core arms place ICC and author-faithful Chipmunk under the same Attention background. An eighth N-only arm is required for standalone/synergy claims; native-Attention ICC/Chip arms are required for separate FFN-only superiority claims.

Local relative risk is defined after within-source expert/layer/seed aggregation; low denominators are handled without silent deletion. Timing uses three no-observer repeats, median within source/seed/arm, then paired log ratios and source/stratum aggregation. Repeats do not increase independent n.

Dense bank distinguishes 192 captured conditions from 194 executions including two plain neutral controls. T1/T2 distinguishes 48 Q/N runs from an optional 24 same-Attention Dense references. Confirmation distinguishes 1344 conditions from 4032 timed executions at seven arms, 96 sources, two seeds and three repeats.

The draft keeps R1b solver rechecks closed, does not treat omega/full column rank as sufficient coverage, reuses identical C96 subsets, preserves actual deployed matrices, and separates full-M writes from sampled-row observations.

execution_binding_requirements: Bind real source identities, model/producer/recipe hashes, data locators and finite compute/storage budgets in each RUN_SPEC; planned slots are not runnable assets.
Specify the exact O/D timestep-pair indices, amplitude common-support bins and inclusion rules before reading the corresponding DEV method outcomes.
Bind typed BF16 anchor/cache/gate/writeback semantics and the convention for sequential joint interventions in the concrete implementation.

Validate metric normalization, motion visibility/coverage definitions and reviewer implementation on DEV, then freeze the chosen SPEED or QUALITY contract and the final confirmation sample size before opening confirmation results.
Maintain required independent execution review, recheck, ACTIVE registration and actual RUN/EXIT evidence; this design approval does not grant model execution permission.
conclusion: All six prior substantive design issues are resolved in the reviewed hash. The revised roadmap is coherent enough to proceed to concrete asset binding and per-scope execution review. This disposition concerns design only and makes no claim about method effectiveness, completed sampling, or GPU execution approval.
